name: Unbreakable Sorrow
disable: DC 32 Deception check or DC 32 Performance check (master) to laugh away the sadness, DC 31 Occultism check (expert) to banish the psychic imprint, DC 33 Thievery check (master) to disperse the emotional energy
reset: The trap resets automatically after 24 hours.

items.name: Mourn
items.text:
Trigger A living creature approaches the statue

---

Effect The trap deals 4d10+14 mental damage to all creatures in the room (DC 28 basic Will save save). On a failed save, a creature additionally falls Prone and begins to weep, taking 1d10 persistent,mental damage.

text: The PCs hear the sound of sobbing and feel an overwhelming sense of sorrow, as if they'd lost something more precious to them than their own life.
